Businesswoman [[Solida Hesk]] ran a '''mining corporation''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Her corporation was the first to discover the valuable [[isotope-5]] reserves within the planet.
